scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hello, I recently applied for a housing loan and I'm checking on the status of my application. Can you tell me if it has been approved or denied? Also, what is the interest rate I've been offered?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been denied. The record does not include an interest rate because your application was not approved.

dialogue.user: I see. Can you tell me why my application was denied? Also, what type of loan product was I considered for?
dialogue.agent: Your application was denied due to collateral issues. You were considered for a Conventional:First Lien loan product.

dialogue.user: I understand. What exactly are collateral issues? Also, what is the total cost of the loan?
dialogue.agent: Collateral issues refer to problems with the property securing the loan, such as insufficient value or condition. The total loan costs are not available in the record.

dialogue.user: I see. Is there anything I can do to address the collateral issues and reapply? Also, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: The record does not include information on how to address collateral issues or reapply. The loan has not been transferred or sold to another institution because it was denied.

dialogue.user: I understand. Thank you for the information. Based on the conversation, I feel <Neutral> because while I got some answers, I'm still unsure about the next steps.
